pages.text: The Fort's Royal Trials pit intruders against the Tribe's elite. Grunt Captains, Mages, and Brutes each represent a different battlefield problem.$(br2)Your first defeat of each Captain is recorded wherever it occurs. Clear all three trials and the Ogre King rises to meet you. Challenge him before you have finished and every Captain you have not yet beaten comes to his aid. Prepare to change tactics rather than forcing one weapon through every trial.
Know the captains before the arena teaches the lesson more forcefully.
